main_text.head: AB AΓ.
main_text.p: Ἀβγὴς ἐνὸ ἡ non onerosus, 2.Cor. 11.9. compos.ex α priv. & βαρὺς onus. Them. βαρὺς ἀαυ. gravis, e.
Ἀββὰ ὁ nomen Syriacum, ἀπλίζων, pater, Rom. 8.15. ab Hebr. אבא.
Ἀβυσσος ὁ ἡ infinitae profunditatis vorago, comp.ex α priv. & βυσσος ὁ Ionicè (pro βυσ- σος ὁ) fundum, pars ima, gehenna, Luc.8.31.
Ἀγαθὸς ἡ ὀν bonus a um, Matth.19.17.compar. κρείσσων, Attice κρείττων, Dor. κρέσσων & κάρρων. item βελτίων, melior. superl. κράτιστος, βέλτιστος, ἄριστος, optimus.
Ἀγαθοεργὸς & contracte ἀγαθουργὸς ὁ benefi- cus. compos.ex ἀγαθὸς bonus. & ἐργὸν opus.
Ἀγαθοεργέω ῶ benefacio, beneficentia profe- quor, 1.Tim.6.18. F. ἠσω. P. ἠγαθοεργηκα.
Ἀγαθοποιέω ῶ beneficio afficio. item recte ago. F. ἀγαθοποιήσω. a.1. ἠγαθοποίησα. cum accus. Luc.6.33.
Ἀγαθοποιὸς ὁ ἡ recte agens, beneficus a.
Ἀγαθωσύνης ἡ proprie bonitas. item studium & cupiditas benefaciendi omnibus, Gal.5.22.

page.notes: Greek and Hebrew words transcribed as legible in the scan; some Greek accents and superscript letters in the lower lines are doubtful. The Hebrew "אבא" is approximated. The narrow left strip (partly visible neighbouring page text) was not transcribed.
